sections.title: REGULATION FD DISCLOSURE
sections.text:
On October 13, 2026, The Procter & Gamble Company (the "Company") issued a news release announcing that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly dividend of $1.0885 per share on the Common Stock and on the Series A and Series B ESOP Convertible Class A Preferred Stock of the Company, payable on or after November 16, 2026 to Common Stock shareholders of record at the close of business on October 23, 2026, and to Series A and Series B ESOP Convertible Class A Preferred Stock shareholders of record at the start of business on October 23, 2026.
In addition, the Company announced that, according to preliminary voting results, the Company’s twelve Director nominees were elected to the Company’s Board of Directors at the Annual Meeting of Shareholders.
The Company is furnishing this 8-K, including Exhibit 99.1, pursuant to Item 7.01, "Regulation FD Disclosure."
